mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.bio, u.location, u.website, u.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follow uf WHERE uf.following_id = u.id) AS followerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follow uf WHERE uf.follower_id = u.id) AS followingCount, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM user_follow uf WHERE uf.follower_id = #{currentUserId} AND uf.following_id = u.id ) AS followedByMe FROM user u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0
